```{r}

df_raw |> 
  select(speaker) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  collect()

```


```{r}
df_raw |> collect() |> slice_sample(n = 40)
```

```{r}
df_raw |> 
  filter(sp4 == "ARMSTRONG") |> 
  collect()
```

```{r}

tokens1_raw |> 
  select(season, episode, word) |> 
  group_by(season, word) |> 
  collect() |> 
  filter(when_any(
    str_detect(word, "rookie\'?s?\'?"),
    str_detect(word, "^boot\'?s?\'?$"),
    str_detect(word, "^p(1|i)$")
  )) |> 
  count() |> 
  ggplot(aes(season, n, fill = word)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~word) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  theme_light()

```

```{r}

tokens1_raw |> 
  select(season, episode, sp4, word) |> 
  # group_by(season, word) |> 
  collect() |> 
  filter(season %in% 4:5, str_detect(word, "friend"))

```

```{r}
tokens1_raw |> 
  select(season, episode, sp4, word) |> 
  collect() |> 
  filter(sp4 == "THORSEN", str_detect(word, "^p1"))
```

```{r}

tokens1_raw |> 
  select(season, episode, word) |> 
  collect() |> 
  filter(when_any(
    str_detect(word, "rookie\'?s?\'?"),
    str_detect(word, "^boot\'?s?\'?$")
  )) |> 
  mutate(word = fct_collapse(
    word,
    boot = c("boot", "boot's", "boots"),
    rookie = c("rookie", "rookie's", "rookies"),
    other_level = "other"
  )) |> 
  group_by(season) |> 
  count(word) |> 
  filter_out(word == "other") |> 
  # mutate(season = as_factor(season)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(season, n, fill = word)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), position = position_dodge(1), vjust = -0.25) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(end = 0.6, labels = ~str_c('"', str_to_title(.), '"')) +
  labs(x = "Season", y = "Number of Uses", fill = "Term") +
  gg_theme

```

```{r}

tokens1_raw |> 
  rename(doc_id = ep_ID, token = word) |> 
  collect() |> 
  spacy_parse(
    nounphrase = TRUE
  )

```

```{r}

df_raw |> 
  select(ep_ID:type, sp4, transcript) |> 
  filter(type == "dialogue") |> 
  head(n = 300) |> 
  collect() |> 
  mutate(
    row = row_number(),
    doc_id = str_c(ep_ID, "_line", line, "_row", row)
  ) |> 
  rename(text = transcript) |> 
  spacy_parse(dependency = TRUE, nounphrase = TRUE)

```

```{r}

df_raw |> 
  select(ep_ID:type, sp4, transcript) |> 
  filter(type == "dialogue") |> 
  collect() |> 
  mutate(
    row = row_number(),
    doc_id = str_c(ep_ID, "_line", line, "_row", row)
  ) |> 
  rename(text = transcript) |> 
  spacy_parse(dependency = TRUE, nounphrase = TRUE) |> 
  filter(pos != "PUNCT") |> 
  separate_wider_delim(
    doc_id, "_", names = c("ep_ID", "line", "row"), cols_remove = FALSE
  ) |> 
  count(ep_ID, token) |> 
  bind_tf_idf(token, ep_ID, n) |> 
  separate_wider_delim(ep_ID, "x", names = c("season", "episode"), cols_remove = FALSE)

```

```{r}

df_raw |> collect() |> use_spacy_parse()

```

```{r}

spacy |> 
  select(season, episode, token:pos, entity) |> 
  # group_by(season, episode) |> 
  # count(entity) |>
  filter_out(entity == "") |> 
  filter(str_detect(entity, "PERSON")) |> 
  arrange(entity) |> 
  collect()
  

```

```{r}

spacy |> 
  select(ep_ID, token:pos, entity) |> 
  filter_out(entity == "") |> 
  filter_out(str_detect(entity, "PERSON")) |> 
  group_by(ep_ID) |> 
  count(token) |> 
  collect() |> 
  bind_tf_idf(token, ep_ID, n) |> 
  arrange(desc(idf)) |> 
  separate_wider_delim(
      ep_ID, "x", names = c("season", "episode"), cols_remove = FALSE
    ) |> 
  slice_head(n = 15) |> 
  filter(season == 5, episode %in% 1:4)

```

```{r}

tokens1_raw |> 
  select(ep_ID, type, word) |> 
  filter(type == "dialogue") |> 
  group_by(ep_ID) |> 
  count(word) |> 
  collect() |> 
  bind_tf_idf(word, ep_ID, n) |> 
  arrange(desc(idf)) |> 
  slice_head(n = 30) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  separate_ep_ID_col() |> 
  filter(season == 1, episode %in% 1:4) |> 
  ggplot(aes(word, idf)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ ep_ID, scales = "free") +
  coord_flip()

```
